name: io.github.IkarusMK/aicortex
title: AICortex
description: Self-hosted brain for any LLM: memory, skills, encrypted vault, devices and scheduled jobs.

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Publish the MCP port on this computer only

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Keeps memory, skills, vault and jobs across restarts

environmentVariables.name: STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Fernet key that encrypts the vault and the sign-in store (openssl rand -base64 32 | tr '+/' '-_')

environmentVariables.name: OIDC_CONFIG_URL
environmentVariables.description: Discovery URL of your own identity provider (sign-in for cloud LLM apps)

environmentVariables.name: OIDC_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID registered at your identity provider

environmentVariables.name: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret registered at your identity provider

environmentVariables.name: BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public HTTPS URL of this server, e.g. https://agent.example.com

environmentVariables.name: JWT_SIGNING_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Signs the server's own tokens (openssl rand -hex 32)
